real resolver/client pair uses the internal image, attaches and removes its invisible loading probe and leaves the previous selection intact when permission is refused
server validates EmoteAnimation and returns the contained AnimationId; nested script never enters the DataModel, repeated selections use cache and other asset types are rejected
the exact LocalPlayer-only restriction is enforced by the double; Photo Mode still loads the verified clip onto the same local copy through Animator, with stop/speed/loop working
rotating the controller changes avatar orientation while the camera transform and studio floor remain fixed; reverse rotation restores the original orientation
over 80 distinct options have human descriptions and real catalog search terms; accents, long aliases, Japanese fashion and selected styles work rather than collapsing to emo
knowledge is feature-specific across more than 30 topics; normal questions are distinguished from outfit requests and concrete steps match the actual game
twelve automatic help questions complete without entering the eight-look interaction limit, reserving a generation slot or querying catalog assets
style and total budget use searchable described radio choices, preserve an explicit confirmation and keep fields/close reachable in six portrait and landscape sizes
saved-look shelf has four primary actions and a separate menu; Delete never calls the server before confirmation and cancelling preserves the stored look
new R6 base and chosen color are previewed without mutation; cancel preserves the current avatar, confirmation creates a clean editable base and Undo restores the prior look
clean-avatar dialog has a visible preview, independent scrollable options, safe entry/close/confirmation and nonoverlapping content on six screens
switching all six themes and restoring the original never has two Cloud instances parented to Terrain at once
manual ID permission refusal and content failure both advance to another real library/queue item; failure never leaves the player stuck on the rejected track
an inaccessible persisted last track falls back through the library, skips an unavailable suggestion and reaches a loaded track without repeating the denied saved ID
the real LocalScript recognizes catalogue, truco and music questions even in make-look mode, skips the outfit questionnaire and remains usable after each new chat
